MAHATMA GANDHI INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES
AND KASTURBA HOSPITAL, SEWAGRAM
No.H/Pers/_________                                                                        Office of the Medical Superintendent
Date :  ____________                                                                        Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram.
Applications are invited on plain paper for the following post alongwith attested copies of certificates and testimonials of educational qualification and experience certificates, so as to reach the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram, Distt. Wardha  442102 on or before 12.11.2018. For the Post No. 1 to 4. the interviews will be held on 15.11.2018 at 03.00 pm, in the office of Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram.
Post
Qualification & Experience
1) Network Engineer -1                      Masters in Power Electronics/ Information Technology. Bachelor degree of Computer Science or IT with minimum 2 years experience. Should have Cisco Certification of Networking with minimum 60% marks. Degree should be recognized with UGC/ AICTE. Publications in IT journals will be an added qualifications.
MCQ test will be conducted before interview.
2) Perfusionist – 1                               B.Sc. with Diploma/Degree in perfusion Technology with minimum 3 years experience with 500 bedded hospital.
3) OT Technician – 1                          B.Sc. with Diploma in Cardiac OT with minimum 5 years experience in a 500 bedded Hospital.
4) X-Ray Technician-1                        B.Sc. with  Diploma in Radiodiagnosis with minimum 3 years experience in 500 bedded hospital.
5) Driver - 2                                        H.S.S.C. having Permanent License of Driving Heavy Vehicle & 5 years experience in any reputed Organization.
Note :
Age Limit  :     30 years- Age and Experience shall be relaxed for an exceptional and suitable candidate.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
